name: hook-verification-coverage

assertion.asserts: every hook script registered in settings.json carries its own verification surface, per EPP-03
assertion.measures: for each `hooks/<name>.{sh,ps1}` matched by a regex over settings.json: whether `hooks/tests/<name>.test.{sh,ps1}` exists on disk, OR whether any file under the configured smoke directories contains the text `<name>.sh` / `<name>.ps1`
known_gaps: measures-presence-not-function (the primary gap, accepted deliberately): an EMPTY test file, or a smoke that merely MENTIONS the hook in a comment or a path list, satisfies the check. Whether the surface asserts anything about the hook's behaviour is a judgment question and cannot be mechanized here -- this oracle bounds the 'nobody wrote one at all' failure, which is the one EPP-03 was written for

registration is found by regex over settings.json: a hook invoked through a wrapper script, an absolute path, or a non-matching filename shape is invisible to the scan, so `checked` is a floor and not a census
text-match coverage is direction-blind: a smoke referencing hook A while testing hook B credits A. A rename that updates the smoke's prose but not its assertions keeps the credit

cost_provenance: re-measured 2026-07-13 on the ULDF framework repo under Git Bash (win32; slowest supported environment): 627-707ms STANDALONE. Raised 600 -> 1200 because the 600 declaration was measured standalone and the oracle runs CONCURRENTLY with ~9 fast-lane siblings -- under lane contention it exceeded its 3x kill (2000ms) and was AUTO-DEMOTED out of the fast lane (oracle-demotions.json, 2026-07-13). An oracle silently demoted for under-declaring its cost stops running while still appearing installed: the same silence-read-as-absence failure as DISC-ORA-02/03, one layer down. Declare for the contended case, not the quiet one -- pessimistic-honest per ORACLE-COST-01.
question: Does every hook script registered in settings.json carry its own verification surface (test file or smoke-harness reference), per EPP-03?

details.applicable: bool (false when no settings.json found -- graceful absence)
details.checked: integer (unique hook script basenames found in settings.json)
details.covered: array of strings (hooks with a verification surface)
details.uncovered_new: array of strings (hooks with NO surface and NOT grandfathered -- these produce status fail)
details.uncovered_legacy: array of strings (hooks with NO surface but grandfathered in the baseline -- these produce status warn)

consultation.typical_sessions_using: framework-development sessions touching hooks or settings.json; /0-uldf-finalize Phase 1a when hook files are in the diff
consultation.note: Gate, not a savings oracle. Enforces EPP-03 (no hook ships without its own verification surface).

fallback: Manually list hook scripts referenced in settings.json 'hooks' blocks; for each, confirm a hooks/tests/<name>.test.{sh,ps1} file exists or a smoke under scripts/csi-tests/ OR scripts/smoke-tests/ references '<name>.sh'/'<name>.ps1'.
baseline_note: The grandfathered-hook baseline (hooks shipped before EPP-03 without a surface) is hardcoded identically in run.sh and run.ps1 and documented in README.md. Remove entries as legacy hooks gain tests.

provenance.note: Arc 2 mechanism honesty (FOUNDATIONS audit 2026-06-11, Theme E / SS 6.2). Verification surface for the EPP-03 clause itself: a clause demanding verification surfaces that had none would be self-refuting.
